description: This file is a PHP source code defining the 'Analytics' class within the OpenCart admin extension controllers. It manages functionalities related to analytics extensions, including listing, installing, uninstalling, and loading analytics modules.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: The Analytics class handles the management of analytics extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing available extensions, installing, uninstalling, and loading their configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of analytics extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the analytics extensions list, including available, installed, and configurable extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a new analytics extension, including permissions, registering the extension, and loading language and view templates.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the removal of an installed analytics extension, including permission checks and cleaning up extension records.
